semantic.justification: Task202610231627-0F8SYR: Writer import API attachment uses canonical document/nodes/registered positions/items rather than a separate document representation. Live SwPaM cursor, selection/paragraph movement, grouped typed properties and direct/default state. Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. Full UNO service metadata/query interfaces, listeners, interactive undo/actions, Unicode cursor navigation, layout, unsupported character/table/conditional styles, ranges in unsupported sections, expanded bookmarks and wider properties remain unverified or unported. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim. Task 202610231745-0YVMQG routes the represented ODT text, paragraph properties, common styles, numbering, bookmarks and cell text through shared XMLTextImportHelper and real Writer text/cursor/style/service owners. Removes SwXMLParagraphTarget and direct ordinary filter item construction. Native table structure and end-document node adjustment retain Writer-specific core responsibility. Character automatic styles use document-pooled handles and CharAutoStyleName; common versus automatic numbering retain separate ownership and export streams. Font scalar members, paragraph controls, page, line-number and consumed property contracts are exercised by focused API/ODT tests. Soft page break XML is ignored as in pinned XMLParaContext. Opaque automatic rule and style names are document-local identities. Full engine/UNO services, unrepresented style families/properties, layout and DOCX remain outside this slice; prior semantic statuses and registered I/O deviations are unchanged. Task SWRD7X follows native XMLParaContext::endFastElement APPEND_PARAGRAPH and XMLTextImportHelper::DeleteParagraph preferred paragraph-component deletion, rather than split/join cleanup that loses empty-cell character items. Actual cursor enumeration, SwXParagraph XComponent deletion and the bounded single-paragraph DelFullPara owner retain paragraph identity and direct formatting. Explicit host Release only releases borrowed API result positions. Tests cover cursor/mark identity, exhaustion, repeated disposal, last-paragraph refusal, populated/empty superscript cell ODT roundtrip and the original no-component deletion fallback. Broader enumeration, redline, fieldmark, undo, event-listener and document-disposal contracts remain outside this bounded integration repair; prior semantic statuses are unchanged. Task SWRD7X retains native owner and dispatch invariants: attached bookmark marks always retain their document/text owners; property metadata validates represented style keys before dispatch; a bounded cursor decrement stays inside the current node array; native generated numbering compounds share one addressed-copy path; an active import cell exists whenever its saved body cursor is present. Remove only redundant impossible alternatives, retaining public invalid-owner and unsupported-property failures. No coverage exclusions, thresholds, semantic statuses or broader parity claims change.
